---
title: VDS Scores
date: "`r format(Sys.time())`"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(jsonlite)
library(lubridate)
library(knitr)
library(ggplot2)
library(DT)
library(tidyr)
theme_set(theme_bw())
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

member_highlight_table <- function(dd) {
    dd %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = year, names_prefix = "t",
        values_from = year, values_fill = 0) %>%
    mutate(across(starts_with("t"), ~ . > 0)) %>%
    arrange(rider_name) %>%
    datatable(
        options = list(
            pageLength = 100,
            dom = "ft",
            columnDefs = list(list(targets = 8:13, visible = FALSE))
        )
    ) %>%
    formatStyle("2019", "t2019",
        backgroundColor = styleEqual(c(FALSE, TRUE), c("none", "lightyellow"))
    ) %>%
    formatStyle("2020", "t2020",
        backgroundColor = styleEqual(c(FALSE, TRUE), c("none", "lightyellow"))
    ) %>%
    formatStyle("2021", "t2021",
        backgroundColor = styleEqual(c(FALSE, TRUE), c("none", "lightyellow"))
    ) %>%
    formatStyle("2022", "t2022",
        backgroundColor = styleEqual(c(FALSE, TRUE), c("none", "lightyellow"))
    ) %>%
    formatStyle("2023", "t2023",
        backgroundColor = styleEqual(c(FALSE, TRUE), c("none", "lightyellow"))
    ) %>%
    formatStyle("2024", "t2024",
        backgroundColor = styleEqual(c(FALSE, TRUE), c("none", "lightyellow"))
)}
```
```{r load}
source("load.R")

all_my_teams <- teams %>%
  filter(mine) %>%
  inner_join(team_riders) %>%
  inner_join(riders, by = join_by(pid)) %>%
  inner_join(riders_prices) %>%
  rename(rider_name = name.y)

#rider_prices_w <- riders_prices %>%
#  pivot_wider(id_cols=pid, values_from=price, names_from=year)
rider_scores_w <- race_results %>%
  group_by(pid, year) %>%
  summarise(score = sum(points)) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols=pid, names_from = year, values_from = score)
```

```{r score_over_year, fig.width=10}
race_results %>%
  mutate(doy = yday(date)) %>%
inner_join(all_my_teams) %>%
group_by(year) %>%
arrange(doy) %>%
mutate(cumpoints=cumsum(points)) %>%
ggplot(aes(x = doy, y = cumpoints, color = factor(year))) +
geom_step(aes(linewidth = year == year(today()))) +
scale_color_brewer(type="qual", palette = "Set1") +
scale_linewidth_manual(values=c(`FALSE` = .75, `TRUE` = 3), guide = "none")


race_results %>%
  mutate(doy = yday(date)) %>%
  group_by(year, doy, pid) %>%
  summarise(points=sum(points)) %>%
  inner_join(all_my_teams) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  arrange(doy) %>%
  mutate(cumpoints = cumsum(points)) %>%
  filter(year == 2020) %>%
  View()
ggplot(aes(x = doy, y = cumpoints, color = factor(year))) +
geom_step(aes(linewidth = year == year(today()))) +
scale_color_brewer(type="qual", palette = "Set1") +
scale_linewidth_manual(values=c(`FALSE` = .75, `TRUE`= 3), guide = "none")
```

## Members


```{r team_members, fig.height=9}
all_my_teams %>%
  inner_join(race_results) %>%
  group_by(year, rider_name, pid, price) %>%
  summarise(score = sum(points)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = rider_name)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = score, color = price)) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "G", direction = -1)
```

## Rank History
```{r pos_history}
tmp_common <- all_my_teams %>%
  count(pid) %>%
  filter(n > 1) %>%
  inner_join(all_my_teams)

rider_ranks <- riders %>%
  inner_join(race_results, by=join_by(pid)) %>%
  group_by(pid, year) %>%
  summarise(score = sum(points)) %>%
  arrange(desc(score)) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  mutate(rank = row_number())

  tmp_common %>%
    inner_join(rider_ranks) %>%
    select(rider_name, year, rank) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = rank) %>%
    datatable(
      options = list(
        pageLength = 50,
        dom = "ft"
      )
    )
```
## Rider Points per Season

```{r year_scores, fig.height=5}

race_results %>%
  group_by(pid, season = year) %>%
    summarise(points=sum(points)) %>%
    inner_join(all_my_teams, relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
    select(pid, rider_name, year, season, points) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = season, y = points, group = rider_name)) +
      geom_line() +
      geom_point(aes(color = season == year)) +
      facet_wrap(~year) +
      theme(legend.position="none")

```
```{r year_scores_table}
race_results %>%
    group_by(pid, season = year) %>%
    summarise(points = sum(points)) %>%
    inner_join(all_my_teams %>%
      select(pid, rider_name, year), relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  ungroup() %>%
    select(rider_name, year, season, points) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = season, values_from = points) %>%
    member_highlight_table()
```
